newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO TO FACE BARCELONA IN SPANISH CUP QUARTER-FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO TO FACE BARCELONA IN SPANISH CUP QUARTER-FINALS.

text.p: The Spanish Cup has been left wide open after the only two big teams remaining in the competition were drawn to play each other in the quarter-finals.

Cup holders Atletico Madrid will face a Barcelona side that squeaked through against league leaders Real Madrid in the last round. Real Betis, third-placed in the first division, face a relatively simple task against struggling Rayo Vallecano.
The only second division side left in the tournament, Las Palmas, face last year's semi-finalists Espanyol, while Celta Vigo and Racing Santander face each other in a mid-table clash.
Spanish Cup quarter-finals (first leg scheduled for February 26; second leg March 12). Atletico Madrid vs Barcelona Real Betis vs Rayo Vallecano
Racing Santander vs Celta Vigo Las Palmas vs Espanyol
